overall_summary: Arun Das has substantial resume evidence in Python backend engineering, including transaction processing, database migrations, recovery procedures, API development, reliability controls, data permissions, and incident response. His AI-related evidence centers on an eight-month support-reply pilot that integrates a hosted language service, handles service and output failures, and keeps humans in the approval workflow.
